CustomField.description: Total recurring charge for this line, net of line Discount. Formula: UnitPrice * Quantity * (1 - Discount) for MRC lines; $0 for NRC lines. (Discount is a Percent field, so in formula context it is the fraction: 100% = 1, 50% = 0.5.) Used by Quote.Total_MRC__c roll-up.
CustomField.label: Total MRC (Line)
